title: Three Nights and One Short Lens
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：quantity　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 quantity 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1967 the observer ① checked the quantity that no assistant in the observatory would have measured, and he said the checking was the whole of the night. The ② quantity, meaning the amount itself and not the lens, ran three nights and stayed unmeasured in the book; a quantity, he said, is the only thing in an observatory that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ quantity in that observatory had the same short lens beside it, and the ④ quantity at the far dome, meaning the reading they kept for the children to note and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A quantity, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the observer said the measuring is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the quantity was the whole of the matter, meaning the measure and not the amount. The ⑥ quantity, meaning the measure and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; quantity, he said, is either something you check or the only word that means both an amount and a measure. He said the measure is the part they remember.

By 1972 the ⑦ quantity had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short lens. The ⑧ quantity of the whole thing, the observer wrote in November, was one observatory and three nights of measuring; quantity, he said, is either the reading at the far dome or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ quantity I remember is the amount measured in the log, which closed in 1974 and is still measured as the quietest in the observatory. A ⑩ quantity, my mother said in 1976, is the only amount that improves by being measured; every quantity, she said, is a measure that has agreed to look like an amount. She said the measure was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 数量（指观测站里每一批旁边的那一批）
B. n. 数量（指那批数量本身，与小小的镜片相对）
C. 固定搭配：check the quantity 核对这一批数量
D. n. 数量（指留给孩子们记的那一组）
E. n. 数量之事（抽象总称，指一处观测站的数量之事）
F. n. 数量（指观测记录里写到、被测量的那一批）
G. n. 数量、多少（指一件事里人人都望却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 多少（抽象总称，指人人都望却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: checked the quantity that no assistant in the observatory would have measured
The quantity, meaning the amount itself and not the lens
the quantity at the far dome
the quantity was the whole of the matter

answers.why: check the quantity 意为“核对这一批数量”，1967 年那位观测员把观测站里没有一位助手肯测量的一批数量做了一遍。
quantity 意为“数量”，指那批数量本身而不是小小的镜片，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被测量。
quantity 意为“数量”，指观测站里每一批旁边的那一批，每一批旁边都有同一片小小的镜片。
quantity 意为“数量”，指最远那座圆顶的留给孩子们记的那一组，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
quantity 意为“数量、多少”，指一件事里人人都望却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这批多少就是那件事的全部。
quantity 意为“多少”，指人人都望却无人提起的那样东西而不是那批数量，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
quantity 意为“数量”，指观测记录里写到、被测量的那一批，到 1972 年这一批成了观测记录里的一行。
quantity 意为“数量之事”，观测员十一月写道，整件事的数量之事是一处观测站和三个夜晚的测量。
quantity 意为“数量”，我记得的是观测记录里测量过的那一批，1974 年记下了，至今仍被说成观测站里最安静的一批。
quantity 为抽象总称，母亲 1976 年说，数量是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的数量。
